classification.systematic_degradation_definition: for any metric, more than half of direction×mode deltas are < -1e-8

directions: both Direction A and B delta J must be <= 0
failure_action: permanently close Judge/Arbiter; do not access Official Valid, change depth, tune thresholds, train Student, or access Test
primary_reference: per-mode fixed stacking fit on inner-train only
trigger_actionability_each_direction: triggered mean actual gain > 0 and > untriggered mean actual gain
